title: AI Replaced My Whole Team?
full_monologue: **This AI skill changed everything.** I used to manage a team of 10, but one AI tool did their jobs faster, cheaper, and with zero errors. It handled content creation, data analysis, and even customer support. I was shocked when the results were better than human output. Now, I’m training others how to use it. What AI skill have you mastered that changed your workflow?
